paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Mishnah Mikvaot, chapter 2, disagreeing with Rabbi Meir, Rabbi Yehudah, Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Shimon.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The checked text of Mishnah Mikvaot 2:10 explicitly spells Rabbi Eliezer in this ruling. Hyman’s abbreviated ר״א is expanded accordingly. This preserves the text’s name form; it does not identify him as ben Hyrcanus or establish that all the cited opinions belong to contemporaries. The chronological fit remains a textual question.

The whole Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Mikvaot 2:10 explicitly names Abba Elazar ben Dulaai and fully writes Rabbi Meir, Rabbi Yehudah, Rabbi Eliezer, and Rabbi Shimon. Eliezer is retained literally, with the existing chronological-fit question and current note verbatim; there is no ben Hyrcanus identification or contemporaneity admission, and no extra ruling is imported.
